turns.text: This one's an interesting… go on, you pick one, you pick one from there, have a look.
turns.zh: 这张挺有意思的……来，你挑一张，你从那边挑一张，看看。

turns.text: Um, what are the top three characteristics you feel are important for a person, in general?
turns.zh: 嗯，你觉得一个人最重要的三个特质是什么，一般来说？

turns.text: I'll choose one, you choose one, then we'll agree on one.
turns.zh: 我选一个，你选一个，然后我们商量出一个统一的。

turns.text: What do you mean by that?
